```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The National Labor Relations Act (NLRA) of 1935 ended the legal stigmatization of labor unions as illegal conspiracies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The NLRA committed the federal government to protecting the exercise by workers of full freedom of association, self-organization and designation of representatives of their own choosing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The NLRA committed the federal government to encouraging the practice and procedure of collective bargaining.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Over the last several decades, the machinery of the National Labor Relations Board has been captured by employers.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Today, the NLRB functions more as an obstacle to union organizing.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Court decisions have narrowed the scope for the exercise of workers’ rights to self-expression in the workplace.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Court decisions have granted full license to employers under the rubric of exercising “free speech” to browbeat and intimidate employees from choosing union representation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Illegal actions by employers to destroy union organizing drives, including the wholesale firing of pro-union activists, have become routine.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The penalties for flagrantly breaking labor law are so limited that employers consider them simply costs of doing business.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Approximately 60 million unorganized workers might choose union representation if they actually had a real choice in a fair election.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Opportunities for union representation are suppressed in the private and public sectors.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
